answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a collateral bond: every AI agent must lock scarce stake before its votes or proofs count, and any detected fake identity forfeits that bond. To mass-produce agents across the grove, an attacker must forge a distinct bond for each one, mined from finite shale reserves, so the cost grows linearly with every copy. The forge of a thousand fake reputations demands a thousand bonds, making the attack unprofitable while honest agents keep their stake.
